notes.title: Halloween loot unlocked!
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween Loot Event[/h1]
[list]
[*]To celebrate Halloween, some of Lux's clothing items have been unlocked until early November. You can add them to her inventory by just starting up the game before then. The items are the Zombie Apocalypse skirt and top, the Skull top, the Skull 'n' Crossbones tank top, the SO top, the Disturbed dress and the X-ray tank. [*]And also because it's Halloween season, next time you're in the underground metro station in New Shinjuku, look out for illuminated pumpkins. If Lux searches them, she'll find bonus clothing items, ammo, medkits and more. There are also some pumpkins at the Happy Stayz Hotel, so take a look there too. They'll disappear in early November, so get 'em while you can. The entrance to the underground metro in New Shinjuku is right near where you meet Cap'n Richerson. You can visit the Happy Stayz Hotel by using the Fast Travel Station near the Rosa Park spawn point.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Ultra Wide Screen support can now be selected at two resolutions from the Options window. The resolutions are 3340 x 1440 and 2560 x 1080.
[*]Lux can now jump over ammo, med kits, shields and watermelons. This makes movement much easier (e.g. she can now just run over shields instead of having to go around them).
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[*]It was possible to keep unlocking items by re-entering the Unlock Goodies code. Fixed.

I've just published build 20190507, and it's a big 'un. The Dogan Outpost has been completely recreated from scratch, and it's much better. Finally, I've reduced pressure on the CPU by moving some method calls out of Update() so they're not executed each frame (e.g. there's no need to redraw the HUD 60 times per second!).

notes.title: The next update is nearly ready!
notes.content:
Hey all,

Apologies for the long delay between updates!

The good news is that the big update is nearly ready. The combat system is finished, and I’m just completing an all-new Appearance system which will replace Outfits. We should be able to start beta-testing in about a week, with a general release to everyone in mid-December.

Here are the main features:
[list]
[*] [u]New combat system[/u]: It’s much more fluid and dynamic. Lux can now move while firing and reloading, and RHETT’s new targeting system helps her lock-on to enemies and easily switch targets.
[*] [u]New Appearance system[/u]: Instead of 27 fixed outfits, there are now hundreds of different items which can be mixed together to create your own outfits. Dead enemies now drop clothing and hair designs in their loot.
[*] [u]Performance improvements[/u]: Average memory usage has dropped from 5GB to 3.2GB. This helps the game run much more smoothly, especially on PCs with 8GB of RAM.
[*] [u]Bug fixes and feedback requests[/u]: I’ve listened to your feedback, and all of the biggest bugs have been fixed. For example, you can now just run over loot dropped by enemies to pick it up, and the Level Up bug is fixed. The scanner behaviour has been improved, there's a new command to bring up a large map, and Lux can now jump as well as roll. And lots more - too many changes and fixes to list here!
[/list]
There’s still a lot more to be done, but I want to get this update out to you ASAP, and then I’ll work on the next batch of changes.

That’s all for now - enjoy your weekend!

notes.title: Developer Update: June 4, 2018
notes.content:
Hi all, welcome to another week! I’ll be posting regular updates here for anyone who’s interested - this is the first. They’re not essential reading, but probably worth a quick scan if you’d like to know where we’re at with the game.

So, a lot was accomplished over the last week. I finished adding our two most important Steam features: Cloud Save and Achievements, and they’re working nicely.

Also, Lux can now carry medkits and shield energy packs to use when needed. She can carry three of each by default, and carry additional supplies by upgrading her inventory capacity in the Skills panel. Her maximum stamina (how long she can run at top speed) can now also be upgraded. Spend those skill points wisely, folks!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32616396/e5f596e0d2a8da2eb8ffc8e401079004ad878713.jpg[/img]

One thing I’d like to complete before the EA release date is to ensure each level is populated with enough content. For example, in one chapter Lux visits a small town in Japan which has been overrun with infected people (a.k.a. zombies). The storyline and missions are all completed and working, but the town itself seemed too placid and deserted at night, so I’ve added a lot more zombies, and it’s really a big improvement. I’ll be doing this right across the game: adding more random enemies that can be fought (for XP and loot) or just ignored.

Also, Lux’s max health and stamina now increase slightly each time she levels up. I actually took this idea straight from Assassins Creed: Origins.  :)  From memory, I think Fallout 3 and 4 also both increase your character’s health each time you level up.

The rest of the week was taken up with various bug fixes. When the game goes live, I’ll post a list of recent bug fixes here.

Tomorrow I’ll get onto making another video, and I’ll send out a post when it’s ready.

That’s all for now - enjoy your week!
